content: If TcpIp_GetNdpCacheEntries () is called with numberOfElements set to zero, TcpIp shall set the parameter numberOfElements to the number of valid entries in the physical address cache related to ctrlIdx, leave the buffer provided by entryListPtr unchanged and return E_OK.
